input.body: ## Step to reproduce 1. Create 4 thoughts with different text, for example A, B , C, D 2. Swipe →↓← to select between or ←↓→ to select all 3. Verify that all of the thoughts are selected and Command Center slides in 4. Tap Favorite 5. Verify that Favorite button is glowing 6. Tap and hold at **ONE** of selected thoughts above, for example Thought A 7. Drag to the right edge to archive them **ALL** 8. Verify that **ALL** of the thought are gone from the homescreen 9. Tap the Eye button to unhide hidden thought 10. Verify that thought A, B, C, D are listed under =archive accordingly 11. Tap the Eye button to hide hidden thought 12. Kill the app on Capacitor app and reopen the app or reload the browser if on Mobile Safari or Chrome ## Current behavior Thought B, C, and D reappear on homescreen. __ROOT__ are shown on Favorite list on the sidebar **Video:** https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/3f60c396-b95a-4f1d-815c-27147b746f05 ### __ROOT__ on Favorite Side bar ## Expected behavior The list of thought data should remain when user refreshes the app
input.title: Archived thoughts reappears when user refresh the app
